Import & Labels
Upload daily Amazon / Flipkart shipping label PDFs, order IDs & addresses auto-extracted
Step 1, Set defaults (applied to all rows in this file)
Step 2, Upload CSV / Excel file
Click to select or drag & drop CSV / Excel file
Amazon: use "Orders" report · Flipkart: use "Sales report" or "Order report"

Step 3, Column Mapping, file.csv

How to get the report files
Amazon
  1. Seller Central → Reports → Fulfillment
  2. Or: Business Reports → Orders → By ASIN
  3. Download as CSV
  4. Key columns: order-id, purchase-date, sku, quantity, item-price, shipping-city
Flipkart
  1. Seller Hub → Reports → Order Report
  2. Select date range → Download
  3. Key columns: Order ID, Order Date, SKU ID, Product Title, Quantity, Selling Price, City
Step 1, Set defaults (applied to all labels in this batch)
Step 2, Upload label PDF(s)
Click to select label PDF(s) or drag & drop
Supports Amazon & Flipkart label PDFs, one label per page
Or paste label text manually
Step 3, Review extracted orders (0 found)
Edit product / price per row if needed. Greyed rows = order ID not found (will be skipped unless you fill Order ID).
Order IDPlatformQty Product NameSelling Price (₹) COGS (₹)GramsCustomerCity / State
How label import works
  1. Every day when you print labels, also upload the label PDF here
  2. The system reads each page as one label and extracts the order ID + customer address
  3. Set the default product + selling price (saves time if most orders are the same product)
  4. Review the table, edit any row that needs changes, then hit Import
  5. Orders are created in your Sales log automatically
Tip: If PDF extraction doesn't work well for your label format, use "Paste label text", open the PDF in any viewer, select all text, paste here.

GST Summary
Regular scheme, CGST / SGST / IGST breakdown
MonthTaxable Sales CGST (9%)SGST (9%) IGST (18%)Total GST Orders
Note: CGST+SGST applies for intra-state sales (same state as your GST registration). IGST applies for inter-state sales. This system uses the customer's state to determine. Please verify with your CA before filing. GST amounts are backed out from GST-inclusive selling prices.
